data.question: What does the policy say about refunds?
data.answer: The policy allows refunds within 30 days of the original purchase, provided the item is unused and in its original packaging. Refund requests submitted after 30 days require manager approval.

retrieved_context.chunk_text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided the item is unused and returned in its original packaging.
Refund requests submitted after the 30-day window require written approval from a department manager before processing.
